subject: Knot theory
lane: Categorification and effective modern invariants: Khovanov and knot Floer homology, cobordism functoriality, spectral sequences, Rasmussen/tau/epsilon/Upsilon, grid computations, recognition/complexity, and bounded current-frontier review.

extraction_method.validation: PDF page counts from PyMuPDF/fitz 1.27.2.3 matched extracted-text form-feed page counts for every downloaded PDF.
extraction_method.limitation: pdftotext and pdfinfo were unavailable. No complete textbook/monograph is claimed.

full_text_read_summary.rule: For each full_text_read source, every PDF page listed was read in bounded chunks; there are no claimed partial-page reads.

sources.title: A categorification of the Jones polynomial
sources.read_sections: Entire paper, §§1-8 including proofs, Conjecture 1, and references.
key_locators: cobordism maps and Conjecture 1 §6.3, PDF pp.39-40
sources.findings: Finite cube complex from Frobenius algebra; d^2=0 by signed square faces; normalized homology is Reidemeister invariant. Movie/isotopy coherence of cobordism maps is Conjecture 1 up to sign in this paper.
sources.source_version_note: The PDF header identifies arXiv:math/9908171v2 dated 1999-08-30; an internal typeset line in the served PDF says November 26, 2024. The recorded arXiv version and SHA-256 identify the exact retrieved bytes.

sources.title: Khovanov homology and the slice genus
sources.read_sections: Entire paper, §§1-5 and references; pages 7-11 were reread after the first pass to check for omissions.
key_locators: definition of s and Lee spectral sequence §§2-3
sources.findings: Lee deformation gives even s and |s|<=2g4. The s=2tau equality is a conjecture in this historical paper; later full Hedden-Ording paper disproves it generally.

sources.title: An introduction to knot Floer homology
sources.findings: Survey describes CFK, HFK, tau, grids, and analytic prerequisites; not a replacement for holomorphic-disk foundations.

sources.title: A combinatorial description of knot Floer homology
key_locators: proof that grid homology computes HFK §§4-5
sources.findings: Grid states are permutations (n!); differential counts empty rectangles; the paper proves identification with HFK by the multipointed Heegaard theory. Detailed purely combinatorial grid-move invariance is cited to MOST07, not proved here.

sources.title: Knot Floer homology and the four-ball genus
key_locators: tau definition and Theorems 1.1-1.2, printed pp.616-617
four-ball corollary and proof, printed pp.628-629
sources.findings: For W smooth oriented, boundary S3, b1=b2+=0, and proper surface Sigma bounding K: 2tau(K)+||[Sigma]||1+[Sigma]^2<=2g(Sigma); B4 yields |tau|<=g4. Proof imports Heegaard Floer surgery/cobordism and Donaldson theory. PDF p.17 has an apparent factor-two typo; theorem and later derivation agree.

sources.title: A survey on Heegaard Floer homology and concordance
key_locators: CFK stable concordance equivalence and tau §2
sources.findings: Defines epsilon in {-1,0,1}, with epsilon=0 implying tau=0 but not conversely; survey is historical to 2017 and cites rather than proves foundational invariance.

sources.title: Concordance homomorphisms from knot Floer homology
sources.read_sections: Entire paper, all proofs, conjectures, appendices, and references.
sources.findings: Upsilon is piecewise linear, concordance-additive, mirror-antisymmetric, has initial slope -tau, and |Upsilon(t)|<=t*g4 for t in [0,1]. Conjectures 1.23-1.24 ask surjectivity of rational derivative-jump data onto direct sum of countably many Z's, for all concordance classes and topologically slice knots respectively; current status not resolved by this bounded review.

sources.title: Knot Floer homology detects fibred knots
key_locators: main theorem and exact hypotheses, PDF p.2
sources.findings: If K is null-homologous in closed oriented connected Y, exterior is irreducible, and top HFK at a genus-g Seifert surface is Z, then K is fibered and F is a fiber. Proof depends on sutured Floer, Gabai decompositions/foliations, JSJ/product-region input, and holomorphic disks.

sources.title: Khovanov homology is an unknot-detector
sources.read_sections: Entire paper, Sections 1-8, all proofs and references.
key_locators: cube spectral sequence and Khovanov identification §§6-8; Theorems 8.2 and 8.12, PDF pp.110-122
sources.findings: Reduced Kh cohomology is Z iff K is the unknot. Integral spectral sequence Khr(mirror;Z)=>I-natural(K); I-natural(K;Q) is KHI(K;Q), whose rank detects unknot by a separate cited theorem. The KHI detector and significant ASD analytic prerequisites are not proved in this paper.

sources.title: Khovanov’s homology for tangles and cobordisms
sources.read_sections: Entire paper, §§1-12, all movie-move proof and references.
key_locators: formal cobordism category and S/T/4Tu relations §§3-4, PDF pp.10-21
tangle composition and gradings §§5-7, PDF pp.22-29
movie moves and Theorems 4-5 §§8.1-8.3, PDF pp.30-39 (printed pp.1471-1481)
sources.findings: Proves formal Khovanov cobordism functoriality modulo homotopy and overall sign via Carter-Saito movie moves; after applying a TQFT, homology maps are functorial up to sign.

sources.title: On the Heegaard Floer homology of branched double-covers
sources.read_sections: Entire paper, Sections 1-6, all proofs and references.
sources.findings: For L in S3, E2 is reduced Kh of mirror with F2 coefficients and the sequence converges to HFhat of the branched double cover Sigma(L), not HFK(L). The paper says invariance of the intermediate sequence under filtered quasi-isomorphism was expected but not proved there (PDF p.4).

sources.title: The Ozsváth-Szabó and Rasmussen concordance invariants are not equal
key_locators: calculation of the twisted Whitehead-double example §§2-3
sources.findings: The 2-twisted positive Whitehead double of the right-handed trefoil has tau=0 and s=2, disproving general s=2tau.

sources.title: On the Upsilon invariant in grid homology
sources.findings: Proves grid Upsilon equals the original OSS Upsilon via a filtered chain-homotopy equivalence after identifying all grid U variables and accounting for W factors; no improved complexity bound.

sources.title: Local equivalence and refinements of Rasmussen’s s-invariant
sources.publication: arXiv preprint, v3 dated 2025-11-13; PDF dated 2025-11-17
sources.read_sections: Entire v3, all main proofs, computational discussion, open questions, and references.
key_locators: computational results/open questions in concluding sections
sources.findings: Defines LEO triples from odd Kh, Bar-Natan deformation, and mod-2 comparison; proves local-equivalence/refinement results. It reports that, among 17,991 prime knots through 19 crossings whose smooth-slice status remained unknown as of April 2023, its refined integer invariants obstruct sliceness for 890 (about 5%); at least 832 of these are topologically slice. Its concordance-group image/structure questions remain unresolved in the paper.

local_supplier_inventory.interface: Objects are complexes in an abelian category; morphisms are chain maps.
Chain-homotopic maps induce equal maps on homology.
Increasing filtration by subcomplexes; no boundedness implicit.
D1_(p,q)=H_(p+q)(F_p C), E1_(p,q)=H_(p+q)(F_p C/F_(p-1) C), no convergence assumption.
Finite filtration per chain degree gives pointwise stabilization and associated-graded homology; no uniform degree bound.
Cobordism between closed oriented manifolds; not an embedded link cobordism definition.
Oriented link is a closed braid under explicit AC assumptions.
Markov equivalence classifies closures under explicit AC assumptions.
Distinct KR/HOMFLYPT braid-complex theory; not ordinary Khovanov/Jones or HFK.
